_comment: The code points a blank provider name holds only (SDD §4.2): Unicode 15.1's separators (Z), controls (Cc) and format characters (Cf), as [first, last] ranges. The API's domain/models.BLANK_RANGES (test_models.py) and the dashboard's lib/providerUse BLANK_RANGES (providerUse.test.ts) both equal it, so every runtime answers alike whatever its own Unicode database (review RV22-06). Regenerate it from a Python whose unicodedata.unidata_version is the version below; test_models.py checks it on one.
